svg.title: Terraform plan
svg.desc: 5 resources, 6 reference edges. Arrows point from dependencies to dependent resources. References are conservative, not Terraform execution order. Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available.

g.text: Line color shows the relationship's own Terraform action, independently of endpoint-card actions.
no independent change: no separate Terraform action is identified. unchanged: an explicit no-op action.
Thin solid arrow from the referenced resource to the dependent resource; not exact Terraform execution
Dashed, undirected relationship. Matching badges identify the same Terraform-backed relationship at both
Dashed line from a Route to its next hop. The destination arrow expresses direction; matching badges
Thicker dotted line shows an inferred, undirected connection; this does not guarantee actual network
Nested boxes show containment; nesting replaces a redundant relationship line.
Hollow circles mark resource/card attachment points; neither end of an undirected line is a directional start. Filled internal
Matching [N] badges identify the same Terraform-backed relationship and its Relationship Resources entry. They do not express
direction or count connections. Reference-only Connections and Dependencies have no number.
